rows.name: Rhode Island Real Estate Commission
rows.constituent: Rhode Island home buyers & licensed brokers
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates Rhode Island's real estate brokers and salespersons. Nine members appointed by the Governor plus the Attorney General and department director ex officio (R.I. Gen. Laws 5-20.5-12).
rows.criticalNote: 9 of 11 seats are governor-appointed (Attorney General and department director serve ex officio)

rows.name: Rhode Island Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline
rows.mandate: Licenses and disciplines Rhode Island's physicians. Eleven members appointed by the Governor — four MDs, two DOs, and five public members (R.I. Gen. Laws 5-37-1.1).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Rhode Island General Laws; RI publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)
